summary: Replaced the configuration-recovery account with a successor spanning all three receipts. Receipt c477da09810f4842ba55130320e2a6b5 has both comparisons violated: event 6 shows the flag-on restart tracking no configuration (index 0) while its log holds the index-1 three-voter entry; event 7 (witness) shows the node's own snapshot metadata recording 0 members at index 0 against the log's three-voter configuration; event 8 (witness) shows a further restart with the replay disabled coming up with an empty configuration and no leader in 1500ms, so the loss is durable rather than confined to the feature. The same receipt re-runs the three-voter scenario (events 0-4) and reproduces the earlier commit-rule witness at index 9, recorded through joint_history across the three executions. Conclusion violated, defect asserted with six knowledge uses (including the new snapshot-metadata behavior), six counterevidence items (reachable removed server, snapshot-only-as-good-as-tracked-state reading, observation-window alternative for the flag-off restart, setup choices, retained harness failure) and four limitations, including that shipping the corrupt snapshot to a follower and automatic-cadence corruption were not exercised.
